_comment: Golf (card game) locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Never translate the action tokens ('[draw]', '[take]', '[swap X Y]', '[discard]', '[knock]', '[peek X Y]'), the card labels (A, 2-10, J, Q, K), the suit symbols, the letters X/Y used as row/column placeholders in tokens, or numeric scores/positions. Keep the ASCII grid layout (spacing, column numbers, '?', 'Col', 'Row' alignment) intact so the board stays readable.

_slots.{winner}: The player number with the lowest score
_slots.{card}: A card label such as A♠, 10♥, K♦ or Q♣
_slots.{new}: The card label that was placed into the grid
_slots.{old}: The card label that was removed from the grid
_slots.{reason}: A pre-rendered phrase describing why the final round started
_slots.{n}: A row number shown at the start of a grid row
_slots.{cards}: The pre-rendered, layout-sensitive cells of one grid row
_slots.{discard}: The card label on top of the discard pile, or the word for 'none'
_slots.{options}: The pre-rendered line listing available actions
_slots.{scores}: The pre-rendered per-player list of final scores

player_prompt.intro:
O dula Golf (Papali ea Karte) - Player {player_id}.
Mosebetsi: Fumana skoare e tlase ka ho fetisisa kateng tsena. Ha kolone e na le ts'ebetso e le 'ngoe, e bonyane e le 0.
Mehlala ea Karte: A=1, 2-10=mehlala, J/Q=10, K=0

Tekanyo (sebelisa tekanyo ka ho fetisisa):
- '[draw]' - Fumana ho tloha dekini
- '[take]' - Fumana ho tloha molomo o o lahlejileng
- '[swap X Y]' - Khetha karte e fumaneng le sebopeho X (lenti) Y (kholo)
- '[discard]' - Lahlanya karte e fumaneng

board.drew:
O ile a e fumana: {card}
Jwale o lokela [swap X Y] kapa [discard] e
board.took:
O ile a e fumana: {card} ho tloha molomo o o lahlejileng
O lokela [swap X Y] ka e (ha e lweke molomo)
board.peeked: O ile a e lebelela ha sebopeho ({row},{col}): {card}

options.final_turns: Metsotso e mpe e khutlela! Dikamano tsa hao: [draw], [take], [peek X Y]
options.must_swap: U tlameha ho: [swap X Y] (u ke ke ua lahla likarete tse tsoang mokotleng oa li-cart)

action_desc.swapped: Player {pid} o khethile {new} le {old} ha sebopeho ({row},{col})

message.deck_empty: Mokatong ha ho letho! Papali e fela hang-hang.
message.knocked: Sebapali {pid} se otliloe! Sebapali ka seng se fumana monyetla o mong hape.
message.final_round: Sebapali sa {pid} {reason}! Sebapali se seng le se seng se fumana monyetla o mong.

invalid.wrong_action: Sebelisa mabana a mabapi a mesebetsi e le 'ngoe: [draw], [take], [swap X Y], [discard], [knock], kapa [peek X Y]
invalid.discard_empty: Mokotla oa lintho tse lahliloeng ha o na letho!
invalid.must_draw_first: O lokela pele [draw], [take], [knock], kapa [peek X Y]
invalid.cannot_discard_taken: U ke ke ua lahla karete e nkiloeng mokotleng oa ho lahloa. E tlameha hore u e fapanyetse ka tse ling.
invalid.have_drawn_card: O na le karte e e fumaneng. O lokela [swap X Y] kapa [discard] e
invalid.need_drawn_swap: U hloka karete e huloang hore u fapanyetsane.
invalid.need_drawn_discard: U hloka karete e huloang hore u lahle.
invalid.out_of_bounds: Sebopeho ha se na mabapi. Tsamaea lenti 1-{max_row}, kholo 1-{max_col}
invalid.knock_with_card: U ke ke ua kokota ka karete e ntšitsoeng. Qetella nako ea hao pele.
invalid.already_knocked: Motho e mong o se a ntse a otlile motjeko ona.
invalid.already_revealed: Karete eo e se e senotsoe!
